title: Grok Review 2025: xAI Chatbot Pricing, Features & X Integration | ToolSchool

facts.fact: According to the page, Grok is included with X Premium+ at $16 per month or available as a standalone SuperGrok subscription.
facts.quote: Included with X Premium+ ($16/mo) or SuperGrok standalone subscription.

facts.fact: The page's pricing section lists X Premium+ at $16/mo, labelled as the most popular option.
The page's FAQ states Grok has a free tier with limited daily usage of about 10 requests per 2 hours for Grok 3.
facts.quote: Yes, Grok now has a free tier with limited daily usage (~10 requests/2 hours) for Grok 3.

facts.fact: The page's FAQ gives the SuperGrok standalone price as $30 per month.
The page's FAQ gives the X Premium+ price as $40 per month, which conflicts with the $16/mo figure given elsewhere on the same page.
The page's FAQ states SuperGrok Heavy costs $300 per month and provides access to Grok Heavy for power users.
facts.quote: SuperGrok Heavy ($300/mo) provides access to Grok Heavy for power users.

facts.fact: The page states Grok's developer is xAI and the product has been around since 2023.
The page reports that Grok has more than 10 million users, without citing a source.
ToolSchool, the reviewing site, gives Grok an overall score of 4.1 out of 5.
ToolSchool scores Grok 4.4 out of 5 for ease of use.
ToolSchool scores Grok 4.2 out of 5 for features.
ToolSchool scores Grok 4.0 out of 5 for value for money.
ToolSchool scores Grok 3.8 out of 5 for customer support.
The page's pricing section states it was last verified on December 23, 2025.
